title: UzEngine VFX System
description: UzEngine VFX file (.uzvfx) — Niagara-style modular GPU particle system. Each system contains one or more emitters, each with a module stack (spawn, update, render). Modules are composable and drive GPU compute shaders at runtime.

bounds.description: Fixed bounding box for GPU culling. If omitted, bounds are computed dynamically (slower).

warmup_time.description: Pre-simulation time in seconds. Particles are simulated invisibly for this duration before first visible frame.

emitters.description: Particle emitters in this system. Each emitter has independent spawn/update/render modules.

max_particles.description: Maximum live particle count. GPU buffer is pre-allocated to this size.

simulation_space.description: Coordinate space for particle simulation. 'local' = particles move with emitter. 'world' = particles detach.

sort_mode.description: Particle sort order for correct alpha blending.

spawn_modules.description: Modules that control particle emission rate and burst patterns.

update_modules.description: Modules that modify particles each frame (forces, drag, noise, collision, color over life).

render_modules.description: Modules that control how particles are rendered (billboard, ribbon, mesh, lit/unlit).

events.description: Event handlers that trigger sub-emitters or gameplay callbacks on particle death, collision, etc.

properties.description: Action-specific parameters (emitter name, sound path, lua function).

type.description: Module type identifier. Built-in types: rate, burst, initial_velocity, initial_size, initial_color, initial_lifetime, gravity, drag, noise, orbit, collision, color_over_life, size_over_life, velocity_over_life, sprite_renderer, ribbon_renderer, mesh_renderer, light_renderer.

properties.description: Module-specific parameters. Depends on the module type.
